transcript: Jai Hanuman gyan gun sagar, jai Kapi Sati hoon lok ujagar, Ramdoot tul. Hello Hello Hello, aa Hardeep ji se baat ho rahi hai. Haan Sir, yeh aapki profile ID mere paas, Kashi Para Spun Pipe Industries. Haan Ismein main dekhta nahi thi, aap apne products ke liye plans wagairah dekh lete hain. Abhi main confirm hoon madam ko main India WhatsApp mein chahiye hoon mere ko dekh raha tha. Nahi nahi main abhi yeh keh rahi hoon ki plans vagairah dekhne se pehle na sir aap apni profile update kara lo hai na. Profile update rahegi toh aapko ek idea ho jayega ki inquiries wagairah jaise aapke paas aati hai toh aap mein matlab kya ki inquiries aati hai kaisa aap unhen tackle kar sakte hain. Hello Madam update ishwar mein ishta profile toh. Nahi nahi sir update kahan hai ismein dekho aapne apna products wagairah toh daale hue hain chaar products dale hue hain ismein RCC chair wagairah pipe hai hai na but in products ki na detail nahi hai like. Kis type se aap inhen sell kar rahe hain hai na kya inki quantity mein sell karenge vo saari details nahi hai agar vo saari details update rehti hai toh jaise aapki koi profile kholta hai toh vo easily connect kar pata hai Abhi dekho kuch bhi nahi hai agar koi aayega toh use kya hi dikhega aapki profile pe isliye keh rahi hoon agar ise aap update karwa lenge na ek baar toh aapke paas direct inquiries jayengi woh aur zyada aane lagengi increase ho jayengi Kya charges lagta hai ismein? Iske liye koi charges nahi lagta sir, plan matlab vo plan vagairah lene ke liye lagta hai charges, agar aap profile update karwaoge toh mere ko bas ek time bata do jis time tak aapna ek agent bhejo jo aapki profile update karta hai. Hai na Main abhi toh free mein hoon main. Plan Abhi nahi, kal ka kal ka koi time bata do, kal das se chaar baje ke beech mein koi time bata do, us time par main aapko bhej deti hoon. Ma'am aap mere ko kal subah das baje tak laga lo na phone, toh main us hisaab se agar kal main bahar nahi gaya toh main bula loonga unko. Kal subah das baje tak Haan Matlab kal agar nahi jayenge toh kal ho jayegi na meeting toh. Haan haan, main bula loonga sir unko. Theek hai, main ek baar na aapko subah call kar deti hoon, uske according aap mere ko bata dena. Hmm. Theek hai, okay, thank you.
